title: Requests to organization settings and policy endpoints fail behind a proxy set only by ALL_PROXY
symptoms: Organization settings or policy never load on a network that requires a proxy
Managed policy missing after upgrading to 2.1.323 while ALL_PROXY is the only proxy variable set
cause: From 2.1.323, organization settings and policy requests no longer use a proxy configured only through ALL_PROXY. Only HTTPS_PROXY is honored for them, so the calls go direct and are blocked.
fix: Set HTTPS_PROXY (and NO_PROXY if needed) to the same proxy address you had in ALL_PROXY before launching Claude Code.
affected: Claude Code 2.1.323 and later, networks that rely on ALL_PROXY alone
